response_requirements.correct: Supply corrected context track/interval IDs and/or boundary_corrections with original position, proposed elapsed seconds and rationale. Each of the four tracks is independently reviewable; do not merge operating and thermal labels.
response_requirements.pending: Null action, time, identity and date mean unreviewed, never zero seconds or a negative review decision.
response_requirements.reject_or_uncertain: Record reason and affected tracks/interval IDs; do not replace with confirmed normal or silently drop the region.
